title: Recursive tuple decoder
statement: Given two functions $\mathrm{base}$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ from pairs of bit strings to bit strings, define a decoder at each natural-number level. At level zero it returns $\mathrm{base}(s,w)$. At level $n+1$, it pairs the level-$n$ decoding of $s$ and the default first projection of $z$ with $\mathrm{dec}$ applied to $s$ and the default second projection of $z$.
hypotheses_covered: Bit strings supplied as decoder inputs
